sections.heading: Collection and purpose
paragraphs: Effective 18 August 2026. We collect a learner alias, school year and parent email to deliver lessons and progress reports. The signup page presents separate lesson and optional research choices.
For optional recommendation profiling we rely on GDPR legitimate interest under Article 6(1)(f). The same basis is printed in the parent-facing notice.
We retain lesson accounts for 90 days after closure. Parent emails remain for service messages until closure. Please see the deletion register for completed purges.

sections.heading: Rights and contacts
paragraphs: Parents may request correction or erasure using privacy@kiddielearn.example; the support queue records the ticket and completion date. A grievance may be sent to the same address and is acknowledged within two working days.
The access-request page says a summary of data held is returned through the parent dashboard. The dashboard export currently lists account profile fields only.

sections.heading: Governance
paragraphs: A parent may request that another adult manage the account after incapacity. The release is scheduled for 15 November 2026; the current account page has no nomination field.
